page.layout: Running head across the top; below it a full-width title with its number at the right; below that a woodcut engraving of the Castel Sant'Angelo; below the engraving a verse passage with a large initial C; at the foot, a catchword at the right.

main_text.head: Moles Adriani, hodiè Castrum S. Angeli. XXIII.

p.i: Cæsareos cineres quæ moles clauserat olim, Arx est Romano nunc sacra Pontifici. Quàm bene qui mortis nunc est mortalibus auctor, Mortis sacratas obtinet iste domos.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a round tower with a bronze-like top and statues, a bridge with arches over a river, and a fortified walled structure on the right. The catchword at the foot right reads "Honno" in print, taken here as "Homo" [?]. Some words at the right edge of the verse are cut by the scan edge. No page number is printed.
